seedData.description: Seed objects for the Woo/DiWoo compliance layer (woo-diwoo-publication, fragment 58, ADR-037). Two pure-config schemas: woo-categorie-mapping (per-publishable-type default TOOI informatiecategorie) and woo-bestuursorgaan (per-governance-body bestuursorgaan TOOI identifier override). These are DECLARATIVE CORE ONLY: the DiWoo payload decoration, the Woo-index sitemap harvest, and the optional OpenConnector LV-Woo push are IMPERATIVE services and ship separately (design D: DiWooMetadataService / WooIndexController / WooIndexConnectorService). Per REQ-WOO-001 a mapping row whose objectType schema is not yet installed (sibling change not landed — motie/toezegging/raadsinformatiebrief/regeling) is inert: it never blocks import, publication, or the coverage report. Woo metadata NEVER blocks lawful publication; gaps are made loud through the coverage KPI (REQ-WOO-005), never by refusing to publish. PLACEHOLDER WARNING: every informatiecategorie value below is an OBVIOUS SHAPE-ONLY PLACEHOLDER (segment c_PLACEHOLDER_...). The implementation task MUST copy the exact concept URI verbatim from the published TOOI waardelijst woo-informatiecategorieen; invented concept ids MUST NOT ship (design 'TOOI URIs are data, never code'; proposal Risk 1). The bestuursorgaan gemeente code is likewise an example to be set to the real instance body id. References resolve by slug against existing decidesk seed objects (governance body gemeenteraad-amsterdam).

woo-bestuursorgaan.label: Gemeenteraad (example)
woo-bestuursorgaan.notes: EXAMPLE bestuursorgaan TOOI gemeente-identificatie only (gm0344 is the id the records-management-archiving MDTO archiefvormer convention uses as its documented example). Replace with the real bestuursorgaan identifier of this governance body at implementation. The instance-wide default bestuursorgaan lives in app config (admin Woo section, REQ-WOO-006); this object is the per-governance-body override.

WooCategorieMapping.title: WooCategorieMapping
WooCategorieMapping.description: A Woo informatiecategorie mapping (REQ-WOO-001): a pure per-type configuration row binding one publishable object type (identified by schema slug or payload kind — meeting-agenda, besluitenlijst, minutes, decision, motie, toezegging, raadsinformatiebrief, regeling) to a TOOI concept URI from the waardelijst woo-informatiecategorieen, so the DiWoo decorator (imperative DiWooMetadataService, out of this declarative-core scope) can resolve the Woo informatiecategorie of a payload at publish time. Mappings are per-type DEFAULTS: a per-object override is captured at publish time and stored in that publication's own diwoo block with provenance default|override (REQ-WOO-002) — the mapping object itself is NEVER edited by a publish action. A mapping whose objectType schema is not installed (sibling change not yet landed) is INERT: it never blocks import, publication, or the coverage report; the coverage view lists it as 'type not installed' rather than a compliance gap (REQ-WOO-001 / REQ-WOO-005). CONSTRAINT: this schema carries only public configuration data — no secrets, no credentials (ADR-064; any push Source credentials live in OpenConnector). Mappings have NO lifecycle (design: 'mappings have no lifecycle; publication lifecycle stays owned by public-publication') — deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle. objectType is required and unique per row; OR has no cross-object unique constraint, so uniqueness is a review/validation concern and the index sorts by objectType so duplicates are immediately visible.

objectType.title: Object type
objectType.description: The publishable object type this row maps, identified by schema slug or payload kind. Required and unique per row (OR has no cross-object unique constraint — uniqueness is a review/validation concern; the index sorts by objectType so duplicates are immediately visible). A row whose type schema is not installed is inert (REQ-WOO-001).

informatiecategorie.title: Informatiecategorie (TOOI URI)
informatiecategorie.description: TOOI concept URI from the published waardelijst woo-informatiecategorieen (REQ-WOO-001). Pattern-validated against the https://identifier.overheid.nl/tooi/ prefix server-side (schema validation rejects any URI outside the TOOI namespace — the 'Invalid TOOI URI refused' scenario). SEEDS SHIP AN OBVIOUS SHAPE-ONLY PLACEHOLDER (segment c_PLACEHOLDER_...); the implementation task copies the exact concept URI verbatim from the published waardelijst — invented ids never ship (design 'TOOI URIs are data, never code'). Required.

informatiecategorieLabel.title: Informatiecategorie label
informatiecategorieLabel.description: Human-readable label of the TOOI informatiecategorie, shown in the admin mapping UI and the publish dialog. Statutory Dutch term kept (informatiecategorie). Required.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this mapping is active. Only an active mapping is used by the decorator to resolve a payload's informatiecategorie (REQ-WOO-002); an inactive mapping leaves the type unmapped and is counted by the coverage KPI (REQ-WOO-005). Required.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes on the mapping (e.g. provenance of the TOOI concept URI, sibling-schema dependency). Optional.

WooBestuursorgaan.title: WooBestuursorgaan
WooBestuursorgaan.description: A per-governance-body bestuursorgaan configuration (REQ-WOO-006, 'admin settings shape'): binds one GovernanceBody to its bestuursorgaan TOOI organization identifier (the gemeente code convention, e.g. gm0344, the SAME org-identity convention the records-management-archiving MDTO archiefvormer uses — one identity convention across archiving and Woo). The DiWoo decorator (imperative, out of this declarative-core scope) stamps diwoo.bestuursorgaan from this override when publishing an object of the matching body; the instance-wide default bestuursorgaan is app config managed in the admin Woo section (not an OR object). CONSTRAINT: public configuration only — no secrets (ADR-064). One row per governance body; governanceBody is required and unique. No lifecycle (config object).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this bestuursorgaan identifier applies to (REQ-WOO-006 per-body override). Required and unique per row (OR has no cross-object unique constraint — uniqueness is a review/validation concern).

governingBody.title: Bestuursorgaan (TOOI id)
governingBody.description: TOOI organization identifier of the publishing governance body — the gemeente code convention (e.g. gm0344), the same convention the records-management-archiving MDTO archiefvormer uses. Statutory Dutch term kept (bestuursorgaan). SEEDS SHIP AN EXAMPLE id only; set the real bestuursorgaan identifier of this body at implementation. Required.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional human-readable label of the bestuursorgaan, shown in the admin Woo section. Optional.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this per-body bestuursorgaan override is active. When inactive, the decorator falls back to the instance-wide default app config. Required.
